The camera appears to travel through this structure, but instead of a rapid rush, the movement slows dramatically, giving the impression of a gentle, rhythmic pulse—a slow, breathing inhale and exhale of light and color that cycles endlessly.

statement: This sketch creates an immersive cylindrical tunnel of crystalline facets that appear to pulse and breathe with light. Using the WEBGL renderer, it generates thousands of faceted spheres that float within a dark space, each animated independently to create a sense of organic movement. The camera slowly traverses through this environment, moving in a gentle, rhythmic pattern that mimics breathing. A dark hexagonal mask overlays the entire scene, creating a unified focal point while allowing the kaleidoscopic colors and light patterns to flow around it. The animation is driven entirely by mathematical functions, creating an endless, hypnotic cycle of light and color that fills the entire canvas without any external input.
